1479-2841-6159-8338.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bloodstained Mire.
1479-2841-6159-8338.description:
Fetch a land using Bloodstained Mire.
When the fetched land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1939-4279-6887--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1939-4279-6887--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom, The Skullspore Nexus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus ability, creating a X/X Fungus creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3641-5900-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
3641-5900-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

4377-7370-7874.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling The Immortal Weapons.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning The Immortal Weapons from exile to the battlefield.
When The Immortal Weapons enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

3532-5078-7010-7742.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-7010-7742.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
3532-5078-7010-7742.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Machinesmith Automaton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Machinesmith Automaton.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

851-1563-3899-5434.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

618-3075-4456-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying at most {1}{R} due to Mizzix of the Izmagnus.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
618-3075-4456-7494.notes: If you have more experience counters, the starting cost is reduced by {1} and you'll net infinite red mana.

240-647-5147-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 2.

7-4217-7101.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-4217-7101.description:
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Hamza.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Hamza.
Repeat from step 3.

3967-4396-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
3967-4396-4871-5220.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1292-3117-5078-7052.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

225-539-751-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have a permanent card in your graveyard.
225-539-751-6071.description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {U}
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Shrieking Drake enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping The Core.
Repeat.
225-539-751-6071.notes:

147-5686-6819.description:
Cast Vincent's Limit Break by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Vincent's Limit Break, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Vincent's Limit Break.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Shilgengar abilities from step 5.

431-2557-3129-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-2557-3129-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

679-3473.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 20 or higher.
679-3473.description:
Cast Transcendence by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}.
Transcendence triggers due to you having 20 or more life. However, you cannot lose the game due to Lich's Mastery.
Step 2 repeats in an infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.
679-3473.notes: Note that if Lich's Mastery is removed from the battlefield, you will lose the game due to Transcendence's effect.

1491-3755-6218-6627.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-3755-6218-6627.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-3755-6218-6627.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

372-4200-5887.notablePrerequisites:
Icewind Stalwart exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Werefox Bodyguard.
372-4200-5887.description:
Cast Werefox Bodyguard by paying its mana cost.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Icewind Stalwart to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Werefox Bodyguard.
Werefox Bodyguard leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Abdel Adrian to return to the battlefield from exile and triggering Abdel Adrian and Werefox Bodyguard.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Icewind Stalwart and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Abdel Adrian until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-3967-5223.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-3967-5223.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

147-2511-3645.description:
Cast Black Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{B}
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Black Sun's Twilight.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Black Sun's Twilight
Resolve the Black Sun's Twilight copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

997-1430-5011.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Mirror Image.
When Mirror Image dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

864-1312-2034-4068-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
864-1312-2034-4068-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Doomed Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing it.
When Doomed Necromancer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Doomed Necromancer ability, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Doomed Necromancer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Doomed Necromancer by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

647-1550-4251.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any Samurai you control.
Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached cannot be blocked by an opponent.
647-1550-4251.description:
Declare Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Godo and the Samurai that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, causing you to exile Godo, then search your library for a basic land card and exile it, then put the land and Godo from exile onto the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1339-2034-3000-5185.description:
Activate Tymora's Invoker by paying {8}, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Insects and Squirrels, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.

2493-2963-4872.description:

At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

231-1361-2419-4067.description:
Activate Ancient Den by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Treasure Vault, untapping Ancient Den.
Activate Ancient Den by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning Ancient Den from the battlefield to your hand, returning Treasure Vault from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Ancient Den, untapping any applicable permanent.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning Treasure Vault from the battlefield to your hand, returning Ancient Den from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2292-2781-5210.notablePrerequisites: Liliana has at least four loyalty counters.
2292-2781-5210.description:
Sacrifice Felidar Guardian to Viscera Seer to scry 1.
Activate Liliana's -3 ability to return Felidar Guardian to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, exile Liliana and return it to the battlefield with 5 loyalty.
Repeat.

1189-3518-4694-5105.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}; it enters the battlefield as a 1/1 artifact creature.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Sigil of the New Dawn triggers, causing you to pay {1}{W} to return Lion's Eye Diamond from the graveyard to your hand.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite white mana, you may repeat the loop adding any color of mana in step 2.
